messages:
maria: Heads-up: exec wants a 'launch runway' plan — code freeze in 3 weeks. We must decide a minimal MVP carve that preserves sales pilots. Proposal: chat core, tenant auth stub, embeddings export API. Cut: custom dashboards, advanced role perms, extensible webhooks to v1.

devon: Agree. Need to quantify infra risk for auth stub; might be a medium effort. I'll add owners & ETA.

anya: Sales asked for tenant export; if we defer, provide a CSV export shim for pilots as a stopgap. Low dev effort.

sam: I'll scope the nav/empty-state + announcement banner. Also need copy that sets expectations for pilots.

sofia: QA note: we need a smoke test checklist for each pilot tenant. Will draft.

maria: Launch criteria: no P1 bugs for 48h on canary, p95 < 300ms on embeddings endpoint, onboarding docs + pilot checklist.

devon: Posting deps matrix shortly. If any owner can't deliver, we default to deferring tenant export.

anya: I'll own the pilot communications doc + feature flag gating.

ops-bot: Reminder: "Runway sync" 2 days before freeze in #all-hands.

maria: Action items recorded. We'll reconvene after the deps matrix to finalize cut list. :thumbsup:
